subject: 99 Revere Beach Parkway Zoning Amendment
overview: The board recommended a zoning map amendment for 99 Revere Beach Parkway and accepted a withdrawal for a project at 2A Mystic Ave. It also held a preliminary hearing for a new drive-through bank at 3085 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: 99 Revere Beach Parkway Zoning Amendment
items.summary: The board voted to recommend that the City Council rezone the property from industrial to mixed-use to facilitate a proposed multifamily development featuring riverfront path extensions and a kayak rental pavilion.

items.title: 2A Mystic Avenue Plan Development District
items.summary: The board voted to accept the withdrawal of the proposal without prejudice after the applicant cited concerns regarding the two-year lapse provision in the city's zoning ordinance.

items.title: 3085 Mystic Valley Parkway Special Permit
items.summary: The board opened a hearing for a proposed Bank of America with a drive-through and continued the matter to July 19 pending technical reviews of traffic, parking, and landscaping compliance.

items.title: 285-295 Mystic Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board voted to continue the site plan review for the H Mart development to July 5.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Miscellaneous
items.summary: The board approved the May 3 minutes and discussed upcoming board vacancies and the scheduling of future agenda items.
